title: active_strategy
description: Canonical memory schema for Agent 2.1 (Strategy Orchestrator) output. Agent 2.1 is the only binding-decision agent: it writes BOTH the active_strategy block and an embedded kpi_contracts object (objectives -> measurable KPI targets that Layer 6 reconciles against). The block is immutable per marketing cycle and must be human-approved (gate_status='approved') before any Layer 3+ agent reads it. | Reads upstream: client_profile (1.1), audience_segments (1.2), competitive_map (1.3), trend_signals (1.4). | Confidence-metadata pattern: DEL-09. | Depends on: ARCHITECTURE.md memory map.

confidence_metadata.description: DEL-09 Data Confidence Tagger pattern — required on every strategic leaf the agent commits to memory.

data_source.description: Origin of the value. 'synthesized' = produced by 2.1's reasoning over upstream memory blocks.

source_detail.description: Human-readable note on how this strategic value was derived. Required in practice when tier is C or D.

channel.description: One prioritized channel in the channel mix, with its rationale and indicative budget share.

role.description: What this channel does in the funnel (e.g. 'top-of-funnel reach', 'lead capture', 'nurture').

budget_share_pct.description: Indicative share of the cycle marketing budget allocated to this channel. Shares across channels should sum to ~100.

kpi_target.description: A single measurable KPI target. Layer 6 (6.1 Performance Analytics) reconciles actuals against these.

metric.description: Canonical metric key, e.g. leads_per_month, cpl_usd, conversion_rate_pct, roas, reach_per_month, cac_usd.

target_value.description: The numeric target. Null only when the metric is acknowledged as not-yet-set and flagged for the gate.

threshold_floor.description: Minimum acceptable value before 6.1 raises an alert. Optional.

client_id.description: Client identifier. Lowercase-hyphenated. Must match the upstream client_profile.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime this strategy was synthesized.

approved_by.description: Human reviewer who approved this binding strategy at the gate. Null until approved.

gate_status.description: Binding human gate. MUST be 'approved' before any Layer 3+ agent reads active_strategy. 2.1 always defaults to 'pending_review'; 'auto_approved' is NOT permitted for this agent.

cycle.description: The marketing cycle this immutable strategy governs. Strategy is re-synthesized per cycle, never edited in place.

horizon_days.description: Planning horizon in days (e.g. 90 for a 90-day SMART cycle).

primary_objective.description: The single binding SMART objective for this cycle. Inherited and sharpened from client_profile.goals; the agent must NOT invent a new direction the client never set.

statement.description: SMART objective in ES-MX (client-facing value). e.g. 'Firmar 5 clientes piloto de educacion privada en Mexico en 90 dias.'

strategic_thesis.description: 2-4 sentence ES-MX narrative tying the chosen positioning, channel mix and budget back to the upstream intelligence (profile + segments + competitive gaps + trends).

positioning.description: How the offer is positioned this cycle vs the competitive_map gaps.

target_segments.description: Prioritized audience segments for this cycle, referencing audience_segments (1.2) by id.

messaging_pillars.description: 3-5 ES-MX messaging pillars that downstream Layer 3/4 agents draw from.

budget_allocation.description: How the cycle marketing budget (from client_profile.budget, USD) is allocated. Client-facing USD only; never expose COGS/margins here.

monthly_total_usd.description: Monthly marketing budget assumed by this strategy, in USD.

currency.description: USD invoicing across all four markets (constraint). Local-currency is reference only.

by_channel_usd.description: Per-channel monthly USD allocation, keyed by channel name.

coherence_note.description: Result of the budget<->objective coherence check (sufficient / warning + detail).

kpi_contracts.description: EMBEDDED second memory block. 2.1 writes both active_strategy and kpi_contracts; kpi_contracts maps each objective to measurable KPI targets that Layer 6 reconciles against. This nested object is the authoritative source of the kpi_contracts block.

objective_targets.description: One entry per objective, each carrying its measurable KPI targets.

objective_ref.description: Which objective these KPIs serve ('primary' or a secondary objective label).

review_cadence.description: How often 6.1 reconciles actuals vs these contracts, e.g. 'weekly' / 'monthly'.

reallocation_rule.description: Bound on autonomous budget reallocation (e.g. '>20% shift requires human per 6.3 rule').

assumptions.description: Key strategic assumptions the reviewer should validate at the binding gate.

upstream_provenance.description: Which upstream memory blocks were available when this strategy was synthesized — drives the gate-summary confidence narrative.
